newsitem.title: LATVIA: HANSABANK LATVIA LAUNCHES OWN BANK CARD.
newsitem.headline: HANSABANK LATVIA LAUNCHES OWN BANK CARD.

text.p: Hansabank Latvia said on Thursday that it had launched its own bank card on Wednesday, which will allow its depositors to withdraw cash from five outlets.
"Card holders will soon be able to transfer money between accounts in the bank," a Hansabank spokeswoman told Reuters.
The bank also said that it has reduced the commission charged for opening an account to 25 lats from 50 lats and to five lats from 10 lats for individuals.
Withdrawing cash with the Hansaabank card is free, the bank said.
